prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Tungsten (W) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a kitchen or galley in her element's kingdom
Hair: her hair tied up in a loose bun or ponytail — same colour and length as the attached image, a few strands loose.
Outfit: a thin-strap camisole with wrap shorts tied at the hip — in denim blues and indigo, with white or cream as the only second colour; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 60-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 40-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: seated on a chair.
COMPOSITION: an environmental long shot, her complete figure and enough of the place around her; body facing the camera; head turned to the side; camera slightly below, looking up at her; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests on her knee.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a bowl of hot food at chest height; it is all she holds.
LEGS: knees together, feet slightly apart.
GAZE: she looks toward the left of the frame.
EXPRESSION: faint upward pull at the mouth corners, lips together, warmth reaching the lower eyelids.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — tungsten: a dark steel-grey metal with the highest melting point of any metal, 3422 °C — it glows white-hot inside a light bulb as a filament and still does not melt; its old name wolfram means 'wolf's froth', because its ore devoured tin in the smelters' furnaces like a wolf, and tungsten is Swedish for 'heavy stone' — it is as heavy as gold; its carbide is nearly as hard as diamond; its ore scheelite glows bright blue-white under ultraviolet light; heavy, taciturn and unquenchable — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
